segments.t: In the hotel lobby, Mikhail pays off a gambling debt to Barinov by singing an ode to the great chef at the top of his lungs. Barinov then orders Mikhail to crow like a rooster without his pants just as Vika walks in, before Elena calls Victor's phone.
